_about: Every item in the game. Referenced by id from shops, loot tables, quests, world loot and saves: never rename an id. `rarity` is a rarities.json id. `reservedFor` lists the only loot tables that may drop an item (a boss's own weapon). Gear states its `itemLevel` and a `statSplit` (shares); its armour, weapon damage, block chance and stats are worked out from item level, slot, armour type and rarity (src/data/scaling.js).

items.name: Worn longsword
items.description: Your own blade. Nicked, honest and in need of a whetstone.

items.name: Watchman's Edge
items.description: A soldier's sword in better repair than its last owner. The watch sigil is still legible on the guard.

items.name: Travelling clothes
items.description: Wool and leather, patched at the elbows. Keeps the rain off, mostly.

items.name: Frayed robe
items.description: Undyed wool gone grey at the hem, its sleeves scorched by candle and worse. Cloth: any class can wear it.

items.name: Dented watch helm
items.description: An iron cap from the old garrison. Someone took a blow in it and walked away.

items.name: Battered kite shield
items.description: Oak boards under a skin of hide, rimmed in iron. It has turned a good many blows.

items.name: Traveller's satchel
items.description: A sturdy shoulder bag. Place it in an empty bag slot to carry more.

items.name: Healing draught
items.description: A small bottle of something bitter and red. Restores 42 health. The body takes two minutes to bear another.

items.name: Grave-iron bar
items.description: A short bar of dark iron, cold to the touch and stamped with a smith's mark.

items.name: Carriage manifest
items.description: A carter's manifest, damp at the edges. The driver's name has been scratched out.

items.name: Iron-studded gloves
items.description: Thick leather with iron studs across the knuckles. Mara's own pattern.

items.name: Hobnailed boots
items.description: Heavy boots with iron nails in the soles. They grip a wet road.

items.name: Mail chausses
items.description: Riveted mail leggings, re-linked where someone was unlucky.

items.name: Iron-faced kite shield
items.description: Oak under a skin of hammered iron, brass at the rim. Heavy, and worth it.

items.name: Rusted falchion
items.description: A broad, back-heavy blade gone orange at the spine. It still bites.

items.name: Warden's hauberk
items.description: Riveted mail to the knee, the watch's tower stitched on the breast. Someone wore it here before you.

items.name: Blackened sabatons
items.description: Plate boots scorched black. The straps are new.

items.name: Blackwood cleaver
items.description: Grave-iron hammered thin around a core of black wood. It is warm in the hand.

items.name: Barrow wolf pelt
items.description: Coarse grey fur that smells of turned earth. A tanner would take it.

items.name: Cracked bone
items.description: A thigh bone, split along its length. Not yours, which is something.

items.name: Bent arrowheads
items.description: Iron heads, too bent to fly true. A smith will take them for the metal.

items.name: Raw wolf flank
items.description: Dark, lean meat from a barrow wolf. A cook with a strong stomach would want it.

items.name: Helm of the Old Watch
items.description: A captain's helm from before the road fell, its brass crest still bright. Whoever wore it last kept the watch to the end.

items.name: Witchbane
items.description: The seer kept this blade bound in roots so no hand could lift it against her. The witchlight in the fuller has not gone out.

items.name: Bloodletter
items.description: A watchman's cleaver that never came clean. Every cut it makes keeps bleeding.

items.name: Plague-Saint's Wraps
items.description: Linen bindings from a barrow priest's hands, stiff with old sickness. What they touch, spreads.

items.name: Shadowstep Boots
items.description: A Blackhedge scout's boots, soled with felt. Nobody ever heard him leave.

items.name: Hunter's Patience
items.description: A boar-hunter's cap with a tusk sewn to the brim. Its last owner waited three days for Bristleback. He waited too long.

items.name: Arming sword
items.description: A plain one-handed sword, light enough to carry one in each hand if you have the knack.

items.name: Ritual knife
items.description: A thin black blade for cutting sigils, not throats. In a caster's hand it sharpens their spells.

items.name: Bone athame
items.description: Carved from a long bone and bound in grave-iron wire. Its spell power is worth more to a caster than its edge.

items.name: Rusty dirk
items.description: A long knife with more rust than edge. Quick in the off hand.

items.name: Militia sword
items.description: Issued to the road militia before there was no road militia. The red grip is newer than the blade.

items.name: Ghoulbone knife
items.description: Someone ground a ghoul's shin bone to an edge. It is lighter than steel and holds a grudge.

items.name: Hunting bow
items.description: A yew self bow, fit for deer and anything that has stopped being one. Goes in the ranged slot: Auto Shot looses an arrow at a target beyond the reach of your sword.

items.name: Rough arrow
items.description: Ash shafts, goose fletching, iron heads hammered out by the hundred. Auto Shot uses one an arrow. Sold by the hundred.

items.name: Barbed arrow
items.description: Arrows with cruel backward hooks. Each shot hits harder than with rough arrows. Sold by the hundred.

items.name: Leather quiver
items.description: A hunter's quiver. Place it in a bag slot: it holds only arrows (six stacks), and drawing from it is quicker, so Auto Shot fires 10% faster.

items.name: Warden's tool pack
items.description: Waxed leather with loops and pockets, from Mara Venn. It has its own slot beside your bags and carries your torch, rods, lockpicks and other tools, so they take no bag space.

items.name: Pitch torch
items.description: Rags soaked in pitch, bound to a stave. Carried in the off hand, it lights the dark places, at the cost of your shield.

items.name: Fishing rod
items.description: Ash and horsehair line. Keep it in your bags to fish, once someone has shown you how. Better rods and bait raise your Fishing skill.

items.name: Yew fishing rod
items.description: Tam's own make: springy yew and a waxed silk line. +10 Fishing skill while it is in your bags, so fish bite more often and are landed more often. Needs Fishing 5 to use well.

items.name: Cut bait
items.description: Strips of wolf meat for the hook. +5 Fishing skill for one cast; one is used each time you cast.

items.name: Gloomwater perch
items.description: Striped and bad-tempered. Good eating, by the standards of the road.

items.name: Silver dace
items.description: A quick, bright little fish. Tam says they bite best in the evening.

items.name: Barrow eel
items.description: Black as the mere's bottom and nearly as old. Tam has caught two in forty years.

items.name: Trail bread
items.description: A heel of dark bread, hard enough to knock with. Restores 100 health over 15 seconds while you sit and eat.

items.name: Spring water
items.description: Cold water in a stoppered skin. Restores 120 mana over 15 seconds while you sit and drink.

items.name: Grilled perch
items.description: Charred at the edges, sweet in the middle. Restores 60 health over 15 seconds while you sit and eat. Eat for 10 seconds to become Well Fed (+2 Stamina for 15 minutes).

items.name: Roast dace
items.description: Small, bright and gone in three bites. Restores 70 health over 15 seconds while you sit and eat. Eat for 10 seconds to become Well Fed (+2 Stamina for 15 minutes).

items.name: Wolf steak
items.description: Tough as a boot and twice as filling. Restores 90 health over 15 seconds while you sit and eat. Eat for 10 seconds to become Well Fed (+2 Stamina for 15 minutes).

items.name: Traveller's stew
items.description: Wolf and perch, and whatever else was to hand. Restores 120 health over 15 seconds while you sit and eat. Eat for 10 seconds to become Well Fed (+2 Stamina for 15 minutes).

items.name: Smoked barrow eel
items.description: Black, rich and faintly sinister. Restores 200 health over 15 seconds while you sit and eat. Eat for 10 seconds to become Well Fed (+2 Stamina for 15 minutes).

items.name: Waterlogged boot
items.description: Somebody's boot. You decide not to wonder where the rest of them is.

items.name: Watch-post key
items.description: A heavy iron key on a rotten thong. The watch kept its coffer locked.

items.name: Lockpicks
items.description: Bent wire and a tension pin. With the Lockpicking skill, they open locks that have lost their keys.

items.name: Greyjaw's Fang
items.description: The old wolf's longest tooth, bound to a grip. The Blackwood went quiet the night it stopped howling.

items.name: Bramble carp
items.description: Fat and muddy-gold, it lurks under the reeds. Hester bakes them whole.

items.name: Ghostfin
items.description: Pale enough to see its bones. The mere folk say it only bites for the unlucky, or the very lucky.

items.name: Baked carp
items.description: Whole, with a crust of salt. Restores 100 health over 15 seconds while you sit and eat. Eat for 10 seconds to become Well Fed (+2 Stamina for 15 minutes).

items.name: Ghostfin broth
items.description: Clear as rainwater and strangely warming. Restores 240 health over 15 seconds while you sit and eat. Eat for 10 seconds to become Well Fed (+2 Stamina for 15 minutes).

items.name: Bundle of firewood
items.description: Dry deadfall from the Blackwood, split and tied. It will burn bright and quick.

items.name: Lump of bog-iron ore
items.description: Rust-red stone, heavy for its size. Mara can smelt it into something useful.

items.name: Mere sorrel
items.description: A sharp-smelling green herb that only grows in the wet ground around the Stillwater Mere.

items.name: Skinning knife
items.description: A short curved blade, kept sharp enough to shave with. Carry it (it rides in the tool pack) and, once someone has shown you how, you can skin the beasts you kill.

items.name: Agna's flaying knife
items.description: Agna Holt's second-best knife, which she says is better than most people's best. +10 Skinning skill while you carry it.

items.name: Boar haunch
items.description: A fatty haunch of wild boar, coarse-haired at the edges. Good on a spit, if someone shows you how.

items.name: Boar tusk
items.description: Yellow, curved and chipped from digging. Children in Brackenford wear them for luck. It did not bring the boar any.

items.name: Boar hide
items.description: Thick, bristled hide, still warm. A tanner will turn it into leather; anyone else will just turn up their nose.

items.name: Stringy wolf meat
items.description: Mostly sinew. The wolves of the ridge do not carry much spare.

items.name: Ridge wolf pelt
items.description: Pale grey fur, thick for the cold up on the ridge. Agna Holt pays well for whole ones.

items.name: Old Bristleback's hide
items.description: A hide as thick as a door and nearly as heavy, scarred by thirty years of fences. Every farmer on the Fallen Road would pay to see it.

items.name: Spit-roast boar
items.description: Crackling on the outside, grease all the way down. Restores 110 health over 18 seconds while you sit and eat. Eat for 10 seconds to become Well Fed (+2 Stamina for 15 minutes).

items.name: Folded letter
items.description: Sealed with candle wax and a thumbprint. On the outside, in careful letters: W.

items.name: Black coffin nails
items.description: Square nails gone soft and black, wet with something that is not water. They came out of the old drain, and before that out of coffins.

items.name: Knotted black rag
items.description: A strip of black cloth, knotted three times. Snagged on the drain stones by someone who did not want to be seen. The Blackhedge bandits wear them round their arms.

items.name: Mining pick
items.description: A short iron pick with an ash haft worn smooth. Carry it (it rides in the tool pack) and, once someone has shown you how, you can mine the ore veins that glint in the rock.

items.name: Rough stone
items.description: Grey fieldstone in fist-sized lumps. Smiths grind it into whetstones.

items.name: Granite block
items.description: Speckled and hard enough to blunt a cheap pick. It makes heavy whetstones.

items.name: Slate
items.description: Thin dark sheets that ring when tapped. Roofers pay for it.

items.name: Marble
items.description: White stone veined with grey, cold in the hand.

items.name: Copper ore
items.description: Green-crusted rock with a red shine underneath. A forge smelts it into copper bars.

items.name: Tin ore
items.description: Dull black grains in pale rock. Smelted with copper, it makes bronze.

items.name: Iron ore
items.description: Heavy, rust-streaked stone from the bogs and ridges. A forge smelts it into iron bars.

items.name: Coal
items.description: Black, crumbly and warm to burn. Smiths will want it for steel, one day.

items.name: Silver ore
items.description: Grey ore with a bright edge where the pick bit.

items.name: Gold ore
items.description: Yellow flecks in white quartz. Heavier than it looks.

items.name: Mithril ore
items.description: Blue-white metal in the rock, light as tin and harder than steel.

items.name: Cobalt ore
items.description: Deep blue ore that stains the fingers.

items.name: Iridium ore
items.description: A dense, glittering ore that almost no forge can melt.

items.name: Raw jade
items.description: A green stone, cloudy until it is cut. A jeweller can split it into shards.

items.name: Skyiron
items.description: Metal from a fallen star, still faintly warm. Smiths need it to punch a socket.

items.name: Copper bar
items.description: A bar of soft red copper. Tempers gear up to level 5.

items.name: Bronze bar
items.description: Copper and tin, smelted together. Tempers gear up to level 10.

items.name: Iron bar
items.description: A grey iron bar. Tempers gear up to level 16.

items.name: Silver bar
items.description: A bright silver bar. Tempers gear up to level 22.

items.name: Gold bar
items.description: A heavy gold bar. Tempers gear up to level 30.

items.name: Mithril bar
items.description: A pale mithril bar. Tempers gear up to level 38.

items.name: Cobalt bar
items.description: A dark blue bar. Tempers gear up to level 46.

items.name: Iridium bar
items.description: A bar of iridium, the hardest metal a forge can work.

items.name: Faint dust
items.description: Grey motes that glitter when no one looks straight at them. An enchanter spends it on gear up to level 10.

items.name: Glimmering dust
items.description: It drifts up out of the pouch if you leave it open. An enchanter spends it on gear up to level 22.

items.name: Radiant dust
items.description: Bright enough to read by. An enchanter spends it on gear up to level 38.

items.name: Eldritch dust
items.description: Black, and it shines anyway. An enchanter spends it on the highest gear.

items.name: Soulshard
items.description: A sliver of a strong thing's will, left where it fell. Still warm. Enchanters need one for the last enhancement on the finest gear.

items.name: Whetstone
items.description: Ground from rough stone. Smiths and soldiers buy them.

items.name: Heavy whetstone
items.description: Ground from granite. Smiths and soldiers buy them.

items.name: Garnet shard
items.description: Deep red and no bigger than a fingernail. Five of them make a gem at a jeweller.

items.name: Amber shard
items.description: Honey-gold and no bigger than a fingernail. Five of them make a gem at a jeweller.

items.name: Onyx shard
items.description: Black and banded and no bigger than a fingernail. Five of them make a gem at a jeweller.

items.name: Moonstone shard
items.description: Milky blue and no bigger than a fingernail. Five of them make a gem at a jeweller.

items.name: Topaz shard
items.description: Bright yellow and no bigger than a fingernail. Five of them make a gem at a jeweller.

items.name: Sapphire shard
items.description: Deep blue and no bigger than a fingernail. Five of them make a gem at a jeweller.

items.name: Cat's-eye shard
items.description: Gold with a sliding line of light and no bigger than a fingernail. Five of them make a gem at a jeweller.

items.name: Jade shard
items.description: Clouded green and no bigger than a fingernail. Five of them make a gem at a jeweller.

items.name: Torn ledger page
items.description: Half a page from someone's accounts, trodden into the road. Right-click to read it.

items.name: Folded orders
items.description: Good paper, folded small, sealed in black wax. Right-click to read it.

items.name: Ditchbell
items.description: A drooping blue flower from the ditches and hedge-bottoms. Bitter. Every draught in the vale starts with a handful.

items.name: Hedge woundwort
items.description: Furry leaves that smell of wet dog. Farmers bind cuts with it. Grows round the vale and the mere.

items.name: Bloodroot
items.description: A pale root that bleeds red when cut. It grows in the dark of the Blackwood, which is where it ought to stay.

items.name: Gravemoss
items.description: Grey-green moss from the old barrows. It grows thickest on the stones nobody should be standing near.

items.name: Starflower
items.description: A tiny white flower that opens only where nothing else is growing. Briony would give a great deal to know what it's for.

items.name: Strong healing draught
items.description: Thick and dark, with bloodroot in it. Restores 90 health.

items.name: Fortifying tonic
items.description: A sour green tonic. +3 Stamina for 15 minutes. Only one elixir works on you at a time.

items.name: Elixir of the boar
items.description: Bloodroot and ground tusk. Tastes of iron and anger. +3 Strength for 15 minutes. Only one elixir works on you at a time.

items.name: Gravemoss tincture
items.description: Cold on the tongue, and your thoughts go very clear and very quiet. +3 Intellect for 15 minutes. Only one elixir works on you at a time.

items.name: Hawkeye tincture
items.description: Eyebright steeped in vinegar. It stings going down, and the world goes sharp at the edges. +3% accuracy for 15 minutes. Only one elixir works on you at a time.

items.name: Blackpool tench
items.description: A fat green-gold fish from the pool in the Blackwood. Slimy, slow, and worth a fair bit to anyone brave enough to sell it.

items.name: Mirror pike
items.description: A long pike with scales like a polished shield. Only a skilled angler can hold one on the line.

items.name: Ash fishing rod
items.description: Seasoned ash and a braided line. +15 Fishing skill while it is in your bags. Needs Fishing 12 to use well.

items.name: Herb knife
items.description: A small hooked knife for cutting stems clean. +5 Herbalism while it is in your bags: you pick faster.

items.name: Brass sickle
items.description: A herbwife's sickle, bright and keen. +15 Herbalism while it is in your bags: you pick much faster. Needs Herbalism 10 to use well.
